additionalResearch.result: 8 explicitly named source cells for The Chase admitted as card_only; printed names and exact source MV link verified; original 2560x1440 collage remains available. Individual 3:4 presentation excludes gutters. Other MV eras remain incomplete.

15 source-named chapter originals recovered across Magnetic, Lucky Girl Syndrome and Cherish (My Love). Tick-Tack chapter images held because original/performance variants coexist. 4 NOT CUTE ANYMORE prior sources returned 403; not bypassed.
30 source-named chapter originals recovered across YoYo, UhUh, LOVE ATTACK, New World, Pinball, Glow Up; later MV chapters absent. kpopping gallery access failed; no unverified image substitution.

limitations: Cropping improves visible foreground composition but cannot restore heads or details already outside the original source frame.
